presets.name: Mono (both channels)
presets.note: Sums left and right to mono, to check a mix or fix a stereo file with one mic.

presets.name: Left channel to both
presets.note: Plays the left channel on both sides: for a recording with the mic on the left only.

presets.name: Right channel to both
presets.note: Plays the right channel on both sides.

presets.name: A little wider
presets.note: Widens the stereo image slightly; check the mix still works in mono.

presets.name: Narrower
presets.note: Halves the width, for a bed that should sit behind a voice.
